body:
Phase 3 (T-161), the arithmetic. Design: docs/archive/specs/2026-09-17-expense-lists-design.md,
"Settling up".

settle(balances) -> transfers, implemented twice — web/src/lib/expenses.ts and
android .../data/ExpenseMath.kt — and pinned by a new `settle` case group in
shared-test-cases/expense-arithmetic.json that both test suites read.

Greedy: largest debtor to largest creditor, transfer the smaller amount, drop
whoever hits zero, repeat. Cents exact. Deterministic: candidates by amount
descending then account id; transfers in the order found. Cases must cover:
two people; a chain; ties in amount (the ordering rule); a former member in
debt and in credit; all zero; a single participant; a leftover-cent balance.
title: expenses: settle-up algorithm on both clients, with shared cases
